common_patterns.filter_mechanism: All report/listing pages use `periode` input (month picker) + DataTable server-side; some add `warehouse`, `showAll`, `busdev`, or `goods` selects
common_patterns.ui_framework: Bootstrap-based + DataTables.js + DateRangePicker + Chart.js (varies per page)
common_patterns.date_filter: Single `periode` field on all reports (period, not date range). No start_date/end_date inputs visible — they are server-side defaults
common_patterns.table_format: DataTables AJAX endpoint (server-side pagination/search). Most tables show 0 rows on initial render (empty state)
common_patterns.no_forms_on_listing: 0 forms on all 21 listing pages — they are read-only views. Only `guest-book` has 1 form (filter form)

report-profit-loss.logic: Two-column description/balance structure typical of P&L: revenue lines, COGS, expenses grouped by account category; final balance = net profit/loss

report-balance-sheet.logic: Standard balance sheet: Assets (current + fixed), Liabilities, Equity. Closing balance by account

report-trial-balance.logic: Three-period pair (likely opening/movement/closing) with debit/credit each side; aggregates to TOTAL row. Bottom shows 3,483,845,258.46 == 3,483,845,258.46 (debits = credits enforced)

report-general-ledger.logic: One row per GL account; computes movement (Debet - Kredit), running Saldo. Source of truth that feeds Balance Sheet & P&L

report-stock.logic: Stock listing by warehouse with qty/valuation per item

report-stock-valuation.logic: Valuation of stock using costing method (likely FIFO/Average based on ERP config)

report-mutation-goods.logic: Stock mutation: beginning balance + purchases/transfers/sales - ending balance per SKU per warehouse

report-follow-up-customer.logic: Sales pipeline tracking by BusDev rep

report-guest-book.logic: Visitor log linked to BusDev; date+time split

general-journal.logic: GL journal entries. Tipe column = source doc type (Penjualan, Pembelian, Kas Masuk, etc). Referensi = source doc number. Double-entry: Debit/Kredit columns. Status = approval/void state. This is the CHRONOLOGICAL ledger backing the General Ledger report

other-deposit.logic: Kas Bank Masuk = cash/bank deposits (non-AR). Dari = payer, Kas/Bank = GL account credited, Jumlah = amount, Status = approval

other-payment.logic: Kas Bank Keluar = cash/bank payments (non-AP). Kepada = payee, No. Tagihan = bill/invoice ref, Kas/Bank = GL account debited

request-cogs.logic: HPP request = cost-of-goods-sales request tied to sales sample. Pelanggan = customer, Produk = item, Formula = production formula, Jumlah MOQ = minimum order qty. Approval workflow before sales sample production

request-cogs-approval.logic: Approval queue for HPP requests. Status drives next step (sample production -> quotation)

goods-request.logic: Internal goods request (Peminta = requester dept, Penyedia = supplying warehouse). Two-step: goods-request -> goods-request-approval

goods-transfer.logic: Inter-warehouse transfer. Gudang Asal -> Gudang Tujuan = source and destination warehouse. Affects two stock records simultaneously

need-for-goods.logic: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) view: aggregates sales orders -> calculates Kebutuhan Qty (required qty) -> Stok (on-hand) -> Selisih (shortfall) -> Qty Order (PO suggestion). Cross-references purchase history with Tanggal/No. Pembelian/Supplier/Qty/Harga

stock-opname.logic: Physical stock count session per warehouse. Generates variance -> feeds stock-adjustment

stock-adjustment.logic: Stock adjustment posting — usually produced from stock-opname variance. Updates book balance to physical count

guest-book.logic: OPERATIONAL entry form for visitors (the report counterpart is report-guest-book). Captures lead details, MOQ, target market, kategori

key_findings.single_period_filter: Every report/listing uses ONE `periode` field (a month), not a date range. This is the dominant filter across the ERP
key_findings.no_static_tables: Most reports return DataTable JSON server-side; raw HTML shows empty tables — column structure was inferred from header cells in the DataTable thead
key_findings.double_entry_gl: General Journal + General Ledger + Trial Balance + Balance Sheet + P&L form the standard accounting chain (Debit/Kredit enforced; trial balance shows 3.48B = 3.48B)
key_findings.stock_flow: Purchase-in -> stock (increase) -> goods-transfer (inter-warehouse) -> goods-request -> sale -> stock-out. Stock-opname creates variance -> stock-adjustment reconciles
key_findings.cogs_flow: Request COGS (sales sample) -> approval -> production -> General Journal posts HPP when sample is converted to actual sale
key_findings.guest_book_pair: guest-book (entry form, 1 row) and report-guest-book (visitor report, 385 rows) are operational + reporting pair for sales pipeline entry
